# Cncf Edge Delta Reviewer

Review Edge Delta using its official documentation and repository in the Observability and Analysis / Observability category. Edge Delta is a platform for creating observability pipelines, monitoring Kubernetes resources, and querying large-scale datasets. Edge Delta uniquely processes telemetry as it&#39;s created at the source to enable greater scale and cost-effectiveness.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
